g.text: The prescribed graft retains every parameter core
The object map stays G₀ = T_α Q_e throughout
The actual projection can have a naturality defect
L_θ = Q X_θ − Y_θ Q
K_θ = (−1)|ᶿ| Q X_θ H
δK_θ + K_δθ = L_θ
Original nonclosed cochains keep their δθ contribution.
Compose both entire parameter maps
Ĝ = κ̂ Q̂ Ĝ S = κ̂
G₂ = κ₀ q₂ + κ₁ q₁ + κ₂ q₀
Keep the original comparison and all consecutive cuts.
A common object map does not determine these cores.
An actual graded dg operator example
a = E_ug b = E_yf
da = E_vg − E_uf db = 0
q₁(sb ; g) = y κ₁(sa ; y) = −z
G₂(sa | sb ; g) = −z
The q₂ and κ₂ q₀ terms are zero here.
Dropping κ₁ q₁ gives a chain defect +z on f.
All 28 operators preserving the actual retract are retained.
Full one-edge homotopy and prescribed graft cores: Theorem 40.
All degrees, unary terms and the nonzero defect: Exercise 40.
Free bar-module background: Keller, arXiv:math/9910179, §4.2.
